questions.qtext:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer to the following question from the four alternatives given below.

The grouping or assemblage of plants, animals, and microbes found in a natural area such as a forest, grassland, pond, or coral reef is called a biotic community. It includes plant, animal, and microbial communities. The type of biotic community in a region depends largely on abiotic factors like water, moisture, temperature, salinity, and soil type. These factors determine which species can survive in that environment. A species is a group of similar organisms that can interbreed and produce offspring

Which of the following best defines a biotic community?

options.text: A group of only plants living together
An assemblage of plants, animals, and microbes living in a natural area
A group of only animals found in a forest
A collection of abiotic factors in an ecosystem

questions.solution: The passage defines a biotic community as the grouping of plants, animals, and microbes living together in a natural habitat such as a forest, pond, or grassland. Therefore, option (b) is correct.

questions.qtext: The pole-zero and Nyquist plot of the loop transfer function G(s)H(s) of a feedback system is shown below. For this system:

options.text: Both open-loop and closed-loop systems are unstable.
Open-loop system is stable but closed-loop system is unstable.
Both open-loop and closed-loop systems are stable.
Open-loop system is unstable but closed-loop system is stable.

questions.solution: Since, all the poles of the open loop system lie on the LHS of s-plane hence, the system is stable. However, the number of encirclement to the critical point is two means two closed loop poles are located on the RHS of s-plane. Therefore, the closed loop system is unstable.
